anomalies.observed: The VDD pins of both MCUs are on generated unconnected nets. NAVC1 VSS pins 18 and 63 are connected only to each other and not to GND. The +3V3 net, which contains NAVC1 VBAT and many pull-ups, has no connection to the REG2 output +3.3V net.
anomalies.expected: The 3V3 regulator output must feed the MCU VDD pins, MCU VSS/VSSA pins must be tied to system ground, and the +3V3 and +3.3V rails must be connected as the intended 3.3 V supply.

evidence.quote: From these two regulated rails, 3V3 feeds both MCUs (FCC, NAVC) and all I2C sensor ICs

anomalies.impact: Neither MCU is correctly powered or grounded; the board cannot boot or perform its intended navigation/flight-control functions.

anomalies.observed: FCC1 VCAP pins 48 and 73 are connected to the UART3 connector nets instead of to decoupling capacitors.
anomalies.expected: STM32H7 VCAP pins are internal-regulator power pins and must be bypassed to ground with the required capacitors; they must not be connected to UART signal nets.
anomalies.impact: The MCU core/internal regulator loses required VCAP decoupling and UART3 signal lines are shorted to power pins, likely causing instability, incorrect behavior, or damage.

anomalies.observed: The Connections section contains USB connectors and series data resistors, but no otter_CH330 UART-to-USB bridge components appear in the netlist; USB3 and USB4 data lines are unconnected.
anomalies.expected: The specification requires two otter_CH330 UART-to-USB converters in the Connections sheet for programming/debug.
anomalies.impact: The intended USB-to-UART debug/programming interfaces are absent, so the board does not implement the specified USB-UART bridge functionality.
